$comment: Typography pairings. Each stack names a recommended web font first, then installed system faces that keep the same character, so pages look right with zero font downloads. 'webfont' is an optional Google Fonts URL for projects that want the exact faces; 'fonts' describes each web family (variable axes or static weights, licence, and the metric-matched local fallback that cuts layout shift when the web font arrives). Self-host with scripts/fonts.mjs. Scales are fluid between 360px and 1440px viewports.

pairings.name: Editorial Serif + Grotesque Sans
pairings.use: Magazines, portfolios, essays, premium marketing.
pairings.reason: A soft, high-contrast serif carries the voice of a publication; the grotesk keeps captions and navigation out of its way.
pairings.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Precision Dev Sans + Mono
pairings.use: Developer tools, infra dashboards, docs, command palettes.
pairings.reason: A neutral sans and its mono share one set of proportions, so code and interface text line up in dense developer screens.
pairings.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Financial Condensed
pairings.use: Trading, analytics, KPI walls, sports data. Condensed headings fit more numbers per row.
pairings.reason: Condensed headings fit more figures per row; Plex keeps long tables steady and every numeral tabular.
pairings.display: "Barlow Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif-condensed, sans-serif
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Warm Humanist
pairings.use: Consumer apps, health, education, onboarding. Friendly but adult.
pairings.reason: Open, calligraphic shapes read as warm and adult at small sizes, where most of a consumer app's text lives.
pairings.display: "Source Sans 3", "Seravek", "Gill Sans Nova", "Gill Sans", "Segoe UI", Calibri, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Swiss Neo-Grotesk
pairings.use: Product marketing, agency sites, posters. Tight, rational, grid-first.
pairings.reason: A rational grotesk set tight and large is the poster tradition the grid comes from.
pairings.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Classic Book Serif
pairings.use: Long reads, documentation prose, literary sites. Serif everywhere, generous leading.
pairings.reason: Two text serifs tuned for long reading, with optical sizes for headline and paragraph.
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Geometric Product
pairings.use: Startups, mobile apps, fintech consumer. Round geometry, clean numerals.
pairings.reason: Round, even geometry and clean numerals for products people use on a phone every day.
pairings.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Technical Mono Display
pairings.use: Changelogs, terminal products, hardware, lab tools. Mono headings, sans body.
pairings.reason: Mono headlines say the product is made for people who live in a terminal.
pairings.display: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Luxury Didone + Geometric
pairings.use: Fashion, hospitality, luxury retail. High-contrast display, quiet geometric body.
pairings.reason: Hairline contrast at headline size is the language of fashion mastheads and hotel signage.
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Modern Slab + Sans
pairings.use: Learning products, recipe and outdoor brands, sturdy marketing.
pairings.reason: A sturdy slab says practical and dependable without going rustic.
pairings.mono: "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Data-Dense Condensed Sans
pairings.use: Admin consoles, tables with 12+ columns, monitoring. Small, sharp, tabular.
pairings.reason: Condensed and small, for screens where twelve columns have to fit.
pairings.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Friendly Rounded
pairings.use: Kids, games, casual consumer, playful onboarding without going childish.
pairings.reason: Rounded terminals soften the page for casual, playful products.
pairings.display: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Varela Round", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
pairings.body: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Signage Grotesk
pairings.use: Transport, timetables, stations, routes, maps, parking, logistics and wayfinding.
pairings.reason: Overpass is drawn from road-sign lettering, so headlines read like the signs people already follow, and its figures line up in a departures board.
pairings.mono: "Overpass Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Hyperlegible Care
pairings.use: Health, clinics, pharmacies, care homes, public health notices and accessibility-first services.
pairings.reason: Atkinson Hyperlegible was drawn for readers with low vision: letters that are easy to confuse (I, l, 1; O, 0) are made distinct, which matters when the text is a dose or an appointment time.
pairings.display: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Seravek", "Segoe UI", Verdana, sans-serif
pairings.body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Seravek", "Segoe UI", Verdana, system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Stamped Slab
pairings.use: Trades, workshops, coffee roasters, breweries, bakeries, hardware and workwear: goods sold in a stamped bag or crate.
pairings.reason: A heavy slab reads like ink pressed onto kraft paper; the plain grotesk keeps shop pages calm, and the typewriter mono sets weights, batch numbers and receipts like a label printer.
pairings.mono: "Courier Prime", "Courier New", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

pairings.name: Wide Sport Display
pairings.use: Sport, races, fixtures, leagues, festivals, events and tickets.
pairings.reason: Wide, heavy headlines fill a scoreboard or a poster edge to edge and read at a distance; a slightly narrow body keeps fixtures and results compact.
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Document Serif
pairings.use: Law firms, contracts, policy, compliance, courts, public records and long formal documents.
pairings.reason: Literata was drawn for long reading on screens; its optical sizes keep text sturdy at 16px and sharpen at headline size, and its firm, low-contrast serifs read as a document, not a fashion magazine.
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Workbench Sans + Mono
pairings.use: Developer tools on a light ground: APIs, SDK docs, command-line tools, open-source projects and changelogs.
pairings.reason: A sans and a mono drawn as one family, so prose, commands and keys share one rhythm; the mono carries the accent (commands, versions, keys) instead of a neon colour on black.
pairings.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Schoolbook Rounded
pairings.use: Children's learning, schools, reading apps, after-school clubs, libraries and family services.
pairings.reason: Round, open headlines are friendly without baby talk; the body face was drawn to ease reading for early and struggling readers, with wider spacing built in.
pairings.display: "Fredoka", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Varela Round", sans-serif
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Site Condensed
pairings.use: Construction, civil works, plant hire, site safety, builders' merchants and engineering firms.
pairings.reason: Tall, heavy condensed capitals, like the lettering on hoardings and plant, fit long project names in a narrow column and read from across a site.
pairings.display: "Big Shoulders", "DIN Condensed", "Bahnschrift Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", sans-serif-condensed, sans-serif
pairings.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
